name: Yale Children's Diabetes Program — Yale New Haven Children's Hospital

note.text: Real pediatric Type 1 diabetes program at Yale New Haven Children's Hospital; supplies the pediatric endocrinologist and registered dietitian on Timothy's care team. In I2 this organization is a member of the care team transmitted to the dental practice; at later interactions it is a recipient of the encounter summary. Individual clinicians are fictional. NPI shown is synthetic.
